steps.title: Analyze and Plan Design Enhancements
steps.description: Assess the current basic visual interface and plan child-friendly color schemes, premium floating pill navigation, and improved card visuals.

steps.title: Upgrade Color Palette and Resource Values
steps.description: Re-engineer color schemes to use vibrant candy colors and premium gradients for maximum visual appeal.

steps.title: Refine Main Layout XML Structure
steps.description: Revamp the layout with polished paddings, better spacing, dynamic aspect ratios, and clean typography layouts.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Capsule Navigation Styling
steps.description: Build high-fidelity pill-shaped state indicators programmatically for navigation tabs.

steps.title: Enhance Alphabet Grid Cards
steps.description: Add playful 3D-like rounded card corners and rich-color typography to the learning grid cards.

steps.title: Beautify Detail Card Overlay
steps.description: Design an elegant premium modal dialog view with clean frame margins, circular dismiss buttons, and glowing voice actions.

steps.title: Refine Quiz Interaction Visuals
steps.description: Design sleek quiz buttons with soft curved shapes, higher contrast target labels, and intuitive feedback.

steps.title: Upgrade Tracing Canvas Graphics
steps.description: Configure the drawing path brush size and color, and add custom outline guidelines to improve the letter tracing aesthetic.

steps.title: Add Responsive Padding and Margins
steps.description: Ensure the layout adjusts gracefully on screens of various physical dimensions.

steps.title: Review Manifest and Theme Properties
steps.description: Confirm the application compiles correctly against standard Material styles and target attributes.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Compatibility Rules
steps.description: Perform comprehensive validation of syntax structures ensuring clean compatibility without lambda regressions.

steps.title: Building Alphabet Explorer
steps.description: Initiate build compilations and compile package to assemble final deliverables.
